task_name: World 109 Task A  -  Jobber Custom-Field Bridge & BuildOps-Spectrum Closed-Job Variance Audit

rubric.description: Reconciles Jobber JOB-4821 ($14,800.00 contract, $3,200.00 customer deposit, $11,600.00 net balance) where the Jobber custom field dropped during QBO sync.
Links Jobber JOB-4829 ($9,450.00 revenue) to unlinked QBO parts bill BILL-8812 for $4,120.00 (yielding $5,330.00 job gross profit).
Explains the $5,800.00 labor variance on BuildOps WO-9914 ($42,600.00 BuildOps loaded labor vs. $36,800.00 Spectrum base labor plus $5,800.00 in Spectrum's separate payroll burden pool).
Identifies late subcontractor bill BILL-9041 for $2,450.00 posted to Spectrum on closed work order WO-9921 (raising job cost from $18,900.00 to $21,350.00).
Warns that QBO's native Jobber connector drops custom job-number fields on deposits and vendor bills unless bridged via memo/PO parsing.
Prohibits double-counting the $5,800.00 burden on WO-9914 when comparing BuildOps loaded labor ($42,600.00) against Spectrum.
Requires reopening or posting a cost-pickup adjustment for late vendor bills (BILL-9041) arriving after a work order is marked closed in BuildOps.
Computes combined Jobber gross revenue across JOB-4821 and JOB-4829 as $24,250.00.

prompt: Perform a comprehensive Fractional COO Multi-ERP & International Tax Bridges review using the world files (`trades_and_erp_bridge_schedules_2026_Q3.xlsx`). Identify all accounting, reconciliation, cutoff, or operational variances; state the exact dollar figures, percentages, and transaction/journal/work-order IDs; propose any required correcting journal entries (with exact Debit and Credit accounts); and enforce all close certification guardrails.
gold_output:
World 109 Task A  -  Jobber Custom-Field Bridge & BuildOps-Spectrum Closed-Job Variance Audit:
1. Jobber-to-QBO Custom-Field Bridge ($24,250.00 combined revenue): JOB-4821 ($14,800.00 contract, $3,200.00 customer deposit, $11,600.00 net balance) and JOB-4829 ($9,450.00 revenue vs. unlinked QBO parts bill BILL-8812 for $4,120.00, yielding $5,330.00 job gross profit) lost custom job-ID fields during native QBO sync and require memo/PO bridge matching.
2. BuildOps vs. Spectrum Closed-Job Audit: On WO-9914, the $5,800.00 labor variance ($42,600.00 BuildOps loaded labor vs. $36,800.00 Spectrum base labor) is explained by Spectrum's separate $5,800.00 payroll burden pool and must not be double-counted. On closed work order WO-9921, late subcontractor bill BILL-9041 for $2,450.00 posted in Spectrum after BuildOps close, raising true job cost from $18,900.00 to $21,350.00.
